description: This file defines the TaskViewModel class in an Android app, which manages task data and CRUD operations through a repository, exposing data via LiveData and providing methods for task management.

classes.name: TaskViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing task data and operations, interfacing with TaskRepository to perform CRUD operations and exposing LiveData for task list.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Suspended function to fetch a task by its identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task with given title, description, and optional due date.
